free_tier.stated: A free 60-minute trial is available on request: as an individual, 60 free minutes and 2 simultaneous devices; as a company employee, 1000 free minutes and up to 10 simultaneous devices. The standard plan has no recurring free allowance.
free_tier.notes: Minutes count while a virtual device is running; the trial is a one-time request, not a monthly allowance. Individual requests take 5 business days and company requests 2 business days.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a running Android virtual device, not a stored object

retention.stated: Device data is destroyed when a test ends; a browser logout does not stop a device, which keeps running until the configured frontend inactivity timeout or maximum run duration. Recipe saves preserve device configuration.
retention.notes: The maximum run duration is configured by the organization and starts when the device goes online; no default number is published.

egress.terms: not published: no outbound data allowance or price is stated on the pricing, documentation or signup pages read; the service requires outbound TCP 443 to cloud.geny.io and api.geny.io, TCP/UDP 443 to turn.genymotion.com and ws.geny.io, and websockets.

interface_detail: Web dashboard at cloud.geny.io, the gmsaas command-line tool driving devices over ADB, an HTTP API at developer.genymotion.com/saas, and a JavaScript SDK; an API token is created in the account's API section.
tooling: gmsaas CLI (installed by the user) with adbconnect, the HTTP API, the JavaScript SDK, and CI integrations for Jenkins, Bitrise, CircleCI and GitHub Actions; no ADB connection by device IP is supported.
chaining: An Android virtual device reached over ADB fits a CI test pipeline; because test data on the device is destroyed, artifacts must be written to a separate storage record.

limits.value: USD 0.06 per minute per running virtual device; trial: 60 minutes and 2 simultaneous devices for an individual, or 1000 minutes and 10 simultaneous devices for a company employee
maximum 2 concurrent instances on Pay-As-You-Go unless sales raises the limit

limits_note: A maximum run duration configured by the organization shuts a device down when reached, whether or not it is active; a frontend inactivity timeout stops browser-started devices but not gmsaas-started ones. At most 25 API tokens per account.
binding_note: For short paid runs the two concurrent virtual devices on Pay-As-You-Go stop a workload first; the minute meter and the organization's maximum run duration bind longer runs.

identity_cost.detail: Signup asks for an email address and password, with Google or GitHub SSO as an alternative; disposable email providers are not allowed and email verification is required. The default plan payment method is a Visa, Mastercard or American Express credit card; prepaid cards are not supported. A free trial needs an individual personal email or a professional email with company details, and is approved by the vendor.

reliability_note: Browser logout does not stop a device, which keeps running until a timeout; gmsaas devices keep running without a frontend timeout unless explicitly stopped; a maximum run duration can shut down an active device.
confidence_note: Rates, concurrency, card gate, signup gate, trial allowance, interface and shutdown terms are quoted from Genymotion's own pricing, documentation and support pages read on 2026-11-24.
